rules: Second RSA per ad group (agency default is two). The existing RSA stays live as the control.

Altoona omitted: named on the client site but NOT in the campaigns' location targets.
Held until the client confirms: years in business, review rating/count, licensed/insured, warranty, 'Callback <10 min', 'Install start <=7 days', financing.
Pins: none except H1 pinned to the keyword-matching headlines, to lift expected CTR (below average on every keyword with a Quality Score).
